description: Developer tool that runs a check over whichever module it is patched to and prints the warnings and the findings on its screen; it makes no sound

inputs.text: Patching a cable from here to an output on another module makes that module the one checked

outputs.text: Patching a cable from here to an input on another module makes that module the one checked

notes: the screen stays empty until you drag a cable from one of the lint jacks to a jack on another module; that module is the one checked.
the button printing the name of the current test opens a menu of its own, headed Select Test, offering Labels Check, Probe Bypass, JSON Extract, WidgetPositions, WhiteList and MyPatch.
the Output To... button opens a menu of its own, headed Output To, offering STDOUT (if attached), HTML and RACK Log.
the report is written to standard output, to an HTML file opened in a browser, or to the Rack log, according to which Output To item is picked.
the Run 100 times button runs the current test a hundred times over.
